parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no documented border/document friction, no facility or custody rule, and no trans-specific violence are recorded — the sodomy remnants are gone and were never visitor-facing. But the traveller faces a hostile climate with thin recourse: no anti-discrimination law outside HIV, no hate-crime provision, a government that has cracked down on visible LGBTQ presence (2006 club closures, 2012 pride arrests under pretextual charges), organised religious-political opposition, and a 2017 public majority favouring criminalisation. That is tier-3 societal hostility with thin remedy, plus dated police harassment showing a lever exists. Absence of documented trans-visitor incidents reflects thin data, not safety; no LGR machinery is resident-facing and carries no weight either way. No universal-exposure measure or organised targeting is documented, so this sits mid-scale rather than lower.
